profile_requirement.normal: Load the exact independently accepted ProjectProfile revision.
profile_requirement.missing_or_invalid: Load artifacts/project-profile.md and remain read-only until acceptance is independently verifiable.

program.activate_when: An existing or required ProgramControl applies, or the task is an explicit persistent multi-workstream program.

experiment.activate_when: The task is an explicit controlled comparison against a fixed baseline.

secrets.activate_when: The task involves a credential, bearer material, secret delivery, or possible exposure.
